top_signals.title: Wolf: Saudi Pipeline Recovery Not a Quick Fix
top_signals.summary: Oil dropped as a rally driven by supply disruptions left gains looking overdone, and a US industry report pointed to a rise in stockpiles. The situation in the Middle East remains on an escalatory path, with threats to passage through the Red Sea and Hormuz, alongside pipeline damage in Saudi Arabia. Guy Wolf, Global Head of Market Analytics at Marex spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on the oil market reaction. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Traders Brace for Prolonged India Bond Slump as RBI Mops Up Cash
top_signals.summary: A sense of unease is gripping India’s bond traders as they fear the central bank’s push to drain excess cash from the financial system, just as inflation picks up and a global debt selloff intensifies, will spark an extended slump.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
